title: Site-to-Site VPN Tunnel Flapping
symptoms: The IPsec tunnel between HQ and branch repeatedly goes up and down
Tunnel comes up for 30 seconds, then drops
Both peers show IKE phase 1 completes successfully
Logs show phase 2 SA rekeying failures
rootCause: The IPsec transform set on the two peers does not match. One side uses ESP-AES-256-SHA, the other ESP-AES-128-SHA. Phase 1 succeeds because IKE proposals match, but phase 2 fails on rekey because the transform sets are incompatible.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the current IPsec SA state and tunnel status?
steps.hint: Look for the 'status' line - should say ACTIVE for a stable tunnel.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the IKE phase 1 SA status?
steps.hint: QM_IDLE means phase 1 succeeded. If phase 2 fails, look at transform sets.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the IPsec transform set configuration?
steps.expectedCommand: show running-config | section crypto ipsec transform-set
steps.hint: Compare encryption and hash algorithms on both peers.
